sentences.en: I was offered a position as associate professor of medicine and chief of scientific visualization at Yale University in the department of medicine.
sentences.zh: 我曾被耶鲁大学的医学系 提供了

sentences.en: And my job was to write many of the algorithms and code for NASA to do virtual surgery in preparation for the astronauts going into deep-space flight, so they could be kept in robotic pods.
sentences.zh: 我的工作是为美国国家航天局NASA写 帮助NASA做虚拟手术用的程序和算法 虚拟手术用于为深空宇航飞行做准备的宇航员 好把他们封在机器人一样的外壳里

sentences.en: One of the fascinating things about what we were working on is that we were seeing, using new scanning technologies, things that had never been seen before.
sentences.zh: 我们工作中很吸引人的一件事就是 我们能利用最新的扫描科到 看到从前根本无法看到的东西 ——

sentences.en: Not only in disease management, but also things that allowed us to see things about the body that just made you marvel.
sentences.zh: 还可以看到 令人惊叹的人体

sentences.en: I remember one of the first times we were looking at collagen.
sentences.zh: 我记得有一次我们在研究胶原蛋白

sentences.en: And your entire body, everything -- your hair, skin, bone, nails -- everything is made of collagen.
sentences.zh: 整个人体，所有的东西 你的头发、皮肤、骨头、指甲 …… 所有的东西都是胶原蛋白组成的。

sentences.en: And it's a kind of rope-like structure that twirls and swirls like this.
sentences.zh: 它是有绳子一样的结构 像这样拧来拧去的

sentences.en: And the only place that collagen changes its structure is in the cornea of your eye.
sentences.zh: 而胶原蛋白唯一改变结构的地方 就在眼角膜里。

sentences.en: In your eye, it becomes a grid formation, and therefore, it becomes transparent, as opposed to opaque.
sentences.zh: 它会变成一个网格结构 而因此它就变透明了，而不是（犹如指甲般）半透明。

sentences.en: So perfectly organized a structure, it was hard not to attribute divinity to it.
sentences.zh: 组织的如此完美的一个结构， 很难不把这说成是神威所致

sentences.en: Because we kept on seeing this in different parts of the body.
sentences.zh: 因为我们会一遍又一遍的不断看到这个（变化）， 在身体各个不同的位置。

sentences.en: One of the opportunities I had was one person was working on a really interesting micromagnetic resonance imaging machine with the NIH.
sentences.zh: 我曾经有个机会 和另一位为美国国家卫生研究院 研究微型磁共振成像机的人共事

sentences.en: And what we were going to do was scan a new project on the development of the fetus from conception to birth using these new technologies.
sentences.zh: 我们要做的是 利用这些新科技 为一个关于胎儿发育的 新项目做扫描

sentences.en: So I wrote the algorithms and code, and he built the hardware -- Paul Lauterbur -- then went onto win the Nobel Prize for inventing the MRI.
sentences.zh: 而他，保罗·劳特伯尔，则负责硬件 他的磁共振成像后来赢得了诺贝尔奖

sentences.en: I got the data. And I'm going to show you a sample of the piece, "From Conception to Birth."
sentences.zh: 我有那些数据 我这就给大家看这研究的一个样片 “从受孕至出生”

sentences.en: (Music) [From Conception to Birth] [Oocyte]
sentences.zh: ♫♪音乐♫ “从受孕至出生”

sentences.en: [Sperm] [Egg Inseminated] [24 Hours: Baby's first division]
sentences.zh: 卵子被受精

sentences.en: [The fertilized ovum divides a few hours after fusion...]
sentences.zh: 受精卵融合几个小时后开始分裂

sentences.en: [And divides anew every 12 to 15 hours.]
sentences.zh: 差不多12至15小时分裂一次

sentences.en: [Early Embryo] [Yolk sack still feeding baby.]
sentences.zh: 胚胎早期 卵黄依然给予胚胎营养

sentences.en: [25 Days: Heart chamber developing.] [32 Days: Arms & hands are developing]
sentences.zh: 第25天：心室正在发育 第32天：胳膊和手开始成型

sentences.en: [36 Days: Beginning of the primitive vertebrae] [These weeks are the period of the most rapid development of the fetus.]
sentences.zh: 第36天：原始脊椎出现 这几个星期是胚胎发育最快的阶段

sentences.en: [If the fetus continues to grow at this speed for the entire 9 months, it would be 1.5 tons at birth.]
sentences.zh: 假设胎儿九个月都在以这个速度生长…… 它将会以1.5吨的重量出生

sentences.en: [45 Days] [Embryo's heart is beating twice as fast as the mother's.]
sentences.zh: 第45天 胎儿的心速是母亲的一倍

sentences.en: [51 Days] [Developing retina, nose and fingers] [The fetus' continual movement in the womb
sentences.zh: 第52天：发育中的视网膜，鼻子和手指 胎儿在子宫中不断地活动

sentences.en: is necessary for muscular and skeletal growth.]
sentences.zh: 有必要帮助肌肉及骨骼的生长

sentences.en: [12 Weeks: Indifferent penis] [Girl or boy yet to be determined] [8 Months] [Delivery: The expulsion stage]
sentences.zh: [12周:阴茎无动于衷][女孩或男孩有待确定][8个月][交付:驱逐阶段]

sentences.en: [The moment of birth] (Applause)
sentences.zh: 生命的奇迹 掌声

sentences.en: Alexander Tsiaras: Thank you. But as you can see, when you actually start working on this data, it's pretty spectacular.
sentences.zh: 由此可见 当你开始处理这些数据的时候 其实是很壮观的

sentences.en: And as we kept on scanning more and more, working on this project, looking at these two simple cells that have this unbelievable machinery that will become the magic of you.
sentences.zh: 拥有这种难以置信的机械构造

sentences.en: And as we kept on working on this data, looking at small clusters of the body, these little pieces of tissue that were the trophoblasts coming off of the blastocyst, all of a sudden burrowing itself into the side of the uterus,
sentences.zh: 看着身体的这些小小的部分 这一小团组织 转眼嵌入了子宫壁

sentences.en: saying, "I'm here to stay." Having conversation and communications with the estrogens, the progesterones, saying, "I'm here to stay, plant me," building this incredible trilinear fetus that becomes, within 44 days, something that you can recognize,
sentences.zh: 逐渐成为这个三胚层胚胎

sentences.en: and then at nine weeks is really kind of a little human being.
sentences.zh: 并在九周内 基本就变成一个小人

sentences.en: The marvel of this information: How do we actually have this biological mechanism inside our body to actually see this information?
sentences.zh: 这信息令人超凡之处在于 人体内原有的 生物机制是如何 读出这些信息的？

sentences.en: I'm going to show you something pretty unique.
sentences.zh: 给你们看个很别致的东西 这是25周大胚胎的心脏

sentences.en: Here's a human heart at 25 days. It's just basically two strands.
sentences.zh: 这是25周大胚胎的心脏 只有两根血管

sentences.en: And like this magnificent origami, cells are developing at one million cells per second at four weeks, as it's just folding on itself.
sentences.zh: 在胚胎四周大时，细胞 会以每秒上千万的速度生长 就像折纸一样折叠自己

sentences.en: Within five weeks, you start to see the early atrium and the early ventricles.
sentences.zh: 五周大的胚胎，可以辨认出心房、心室 六周大，这些折叠便开始

sentences.en: Six weeks, these folds are now beginning with the papilla on the inside of the heart actually being able to pull down each one of those valves in your heart until you get a mature heart -- and then basically the development of the entire human body.
sentences.zh: 直至心脏发育完毕

sentences.en: The magic of the mechanisms inside each genetic structure saying exactly where that nerve cell should go -- the complexity of these, the mathematical models of how these things are indeed done
sentences.zh: 也要惊叹 这里生物机制的魔法

sentences.en: are beyond human comprehension. Even though I am a mathematician, I look at this with marvel of how do these instruction sets not make these mistakes as they build what is us?
sentences.zh: 我迷惑这些指令

sentences.en: It's a mystery, it's magic, it's divinity.
sentences.zh: 真神秘，简直不可思议

sentences.en: Then you start to take a look at adult life.
sentences.zh: 然后看看成人的生命

sentences.en: Take a look at this little tuft of capillaries.
sentences.zh: 看看这一绺毛细血管

sentences.en: It's just a tiny sub-substructure, microscopic.
sentences.zh: 只是一个很小的，微观的结构

sentences.en: But basically by the time you're nine months and you're given birth, you have almost 60,000 miles of vessels inside your body.
sentences.zh: 但你九个月出生的时候 你体内已拥有 近六万英里（近九万六千公里）的血管

sentences.en: And only one mile is visible. 59,999 miles that are basically bringing nutrients and taking waste away.
sentences.zh: 只有一英里是可见的 其他的59,999英里 输送营养带走废物的血管

sentences.en: The complexity of building that within a single system is, again, beyond any comprehension or any existing mathematics today.
sentences.zh: 在一个独立系统内达到这种复杂程度 重申一遍，是超乎理解的 超过现有任何的科学的可能性

sentences.en: And then instructions set, from the brain to every other part of the body -- look at the complexity of the folding.
sentences.zh: 从大脑到人体每个部位的 复杂指令 看看这折叠有多复杂 而身体从哪里得到

sentences.en: Where does this intelligence of knowing that a fold can actually hold more information, so as you actually watch the baby's brain grow.
sentences.zh: 储存容量的智慧 这也正是我们现在正在做的研究之一

sentences.en: And this is one of the things we're doing.
sentences.zh: 要从婴儿出生开始 每六个月一次，知道六岁为止

sentences.en: We're launching two new studies of scanning babies' brains from the moment they're born.
sentences.zh: 每六个月一次，知道六岁为止 扫描婴儿的大脑

sentences.en: Every six months until they're six years old, we're going to be doing about 250 children, watching exactly how the gyri and the sulci of the brains fold to see how this magnificent development actually turns into memories and the marvel that is us.
sentences.zh: 观察他们脑回和脑沟具体如何发展 观察这个惊人的过程 如何变成我们

sentences.en: And it's not just our own existence, but how does the woman's body understand to have genetic structure that not only builds her own, but then has the understanding that allows her to become a walking immunological, cardiovascular system
sentences.zh: 基因信息不仅需要制造自己 一个行走的免疫、心血管系统

sentences.en: that basically is a mobile system that can actually nurture, treat this child with a kind of marvel that is beyond, again, our comprehension -- the magic that is existence, that is us?
sentences.zh: 一个可以用超过我们理解能力的奇迹—— 来招待这个孩子的系统 一个存在奇迹。我们存在的奇迹。

sentences.en: Thank you. (Applause)
sentences.zh: 谢谢大家。 掌声
